Remark
[a positively curved exception with lower symmetry rank]

Source: petersen:page-0342 ↗ def:pet-ch8-symmetry-rank item 2 does not cover all known examples: the homogeneous space $F_4/\mathrm{Spin}(8)$ is a positively curved $24$-manifold with symmetry rank $4$.
